display.purpose: Social feed, event discovery and page headlines.

body.purpose: Interface copy, labels and event details.

shadows.name: subtle
shadows.purpose: Quiet separation for surfaces that need elevation.

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.purpose: Short color and image feedback, under 200ms for controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action in the event search, booking and organizer flows.
components.css: .ds-primary { background: var(--primary-solid); color: var(--primary-solid-fg); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 16px; height: 44px; font: 600 14px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-solid-hover); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action with a clear outline and paper fill.
components.css: .ds-secondary { background: var(--bg-muted); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 16px; height: 44px; font: 600 14px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-secondary:hover { background: var(--border); border-color: var(--border-strong); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Search field with a visible label and direct rectangular shape.
components.html: <label class="ds-search-label">Rechercher un événement<input class="ds-search" placeholder="Nom d’un événement ou d’une ville"></label>
components.css: .ds-search-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--fg); font: 600 14px/1.3 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search { background: var(--surface); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 12px; height: 44px; font: 400 14px/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Event Card
components.description: Organizer-provided cover and event facts in a flat, bordered frame.

components.css: .ds-event { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); color: var(--fg); transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-event:hover { border-color: var(--primary); } .ds-event img { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; object-fit: cover; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-event-copy { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; } .ds-event h3 { margin: 0; font: 700 20px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-event p { margin: 0; color: var(--fg-muted); font: 400 12px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Compact rectangular tag whose text names the status.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--bg-muted); color: var(--fg); padding: 2px 8px; font: 700 11px/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview: Event feels like a calm, contemporary social network for finding and sharing events. A soft gray canvas, quiet card surfaces, readable graphite type and muted slate-blue actions keep the feed comfortable to scan. Real organizer-supplied covers provide imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Soft gray backgrounds with graphite text and muted slate-blue actions.
Social feed surfaces with compact corners and quiet borders.
Event details and product states are based on real data.
Light and dark themes use calm, reduced-glare tones.

rules.name: The Social Feed Rule
rules.body: Use alignment, avatars, timestamps and light separators to make posts easy to follow. Keep surfaces calm and avoid decorative effects.

dos: Use real event details and media supplied by organizers.
Pair status colors with readable text.
Keep the participant feed, discovery and social connections prominent.
donts: Do not use purple gradients or pill-shaped buttons.
Do not add emoji icons, AI-generated photos, fake testimonials or invented metrics.
Do not use glass effects, floating card stacks or vague promotional claims.
